answer: Treat each new identity like a boat entering a reef harbor: it needs an underwriter who posts collateral and earns a premium. If the identity is later flagged as a sybil, the underwriter pays victims from that collateral. Premiums rise with every tide of new signups from one funding source, so a comet-fast swarm of fake accounts costs the attacker steeply growing premiums plus forfeited collateral, while honest agents pay little.
